account: It is day 0, just after ten, and I have reached the plaza for my scheduled market walk. Townsfolk 10, 20 and 30 are nearby. I have not yet heard any town news from them. The secretary is walking nearby with a writable book; I do not know where she is going. Earlier she thought the appointments chest was empty while I had the appointment book out to read. I returned it, and she confirmed she had it safely, so that exchange does not by itself suggest anything suspicious. She reported no correspondence or confirmed news. Today's appointments include town accounts at one and tea at three at an unspecified east-bank dockside cottage. Neither the book nor the secretary identified the host. I asked her to find out which cottage before I return for accounts. That missing detail is the only unresolved oddity I have noticed. I have a general feeling that something may be happening without my knowledge, but no observed evidence yet of a secret gathering or its purpose. For now, the people I can see appear to be going about ordinary town business; I should hear their news rather than assume more.
